summary: Iteration 16: Validated BillSure UX overhaul — 4-step Bill Setup Wizard. Backend pytest (test_wizard_flow.py): 11/14 PASS. Core wizard flow APIs all work: customer+admin login ✓, POST /api/bills creates bill ✓ (id, provider, amount echoed), POST /api/payment-methods bank_account (with bank_name + bsb + masked account) returns 200 ✓ (NO 500 regression), POST /api/payment-methods debit_card stores card_last4 + card_brand ✓, GET /api/payment-methods lists them ✓, POST /api/bills/extract (multipart PDF) returns extracted fields (provider='AGL', amount=125.5, due_date='2026-02-15', biller_code, account_number) ✓ — no 500, no missing-status-endpoint regression. Frontend E2E (Playwright): /dashboard/bills loads with [data-testid='bills-page'] + add-bill-btn ✓ → click opens [data-testid='bill-setup-wizard'] with progress bar ✓ → wizard-step-upload renders with file area + manual-entry-link ✓ → manual link auto-advances to wizard-step-review with empty form (all 5 testids present: bill-category, bill-provider, bill-amount, bill-due-date, confirm-bill-btn) ✓ → Category Shadcn Select opens and 'Electricity' selects cleanly ✓ → form submit calls POST /api/bills → auto-advances to wizard-step-plan ✓ → step 3 plan options render (plan-weekly/fortnightly/monthly testids present) BUT $ amounts are blank (see HIGH bug below). Created bill cleaned up. NO console errors during full wizard run.

critical.issue: Returns 401 'Invalid token' for valid admin login token. ROOT CAUSE: server.py:1213 REDEFINES get_admin_user() locally, SHADOWING the one imported from utils.auth. The local version only uses decode_token() (custom HS256 JWT) and does NOT support Supabase ES256 tokens. Admin user admin@billseasypay.com now has supabase_uid linked so /api/auth/login issues a Supabase JWT — local get_admin_user can't decode it. /api/auth/me works (uses utils.auth.get_current_user with Supabase fallback). FIX: delete the duplicate get_admin_user at server.py:1213-1223 so the imported one (which supports both token types) is used.

minor.issue: Response omits 'category' field entirely (rest of fields: provider, amount, due_date, account_number, biller_code, bpay_code, frequency all present). Frontend wizard expects d.category for auto-fill — currently leaves category empty. Recommend always returning category=null instead of dropping the key.

Returns nested {options: [{frequency,amount,...}]} but BillSetupWizard.jsx (line 320-324) reads flat calcData.weekly / .fortnightly / .monthly — see frontend issue. Either flatten the API response or fix the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Plan option cards render Weekly/Fortnightly/Monthly labels but the $ AMOUNT IS BLANK (shows only '$' icon and 'inc. 8% buffer'). Cause: component does calcData.weekly?.toFixed(2) but the API returns {options:[{frequency:'weekly', amount:245.11}, ...]}. Need to map either calcData.options.find(o=>o.frequency==='weekly').amount OR change backend to also return flat keys. Buttons remain clickable so flow still works, but user has no idea how much they'll pay.

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): Delete duplicate get_admin_user() in /app/backend/server.py:1213-1223 so the utils.auth version (which handles both custom + Supabase JWT) is used. Currently every /api/admin/* endpoint returns 401 for the seeded admin user.

FIX (HIGH): BillSetupWizard.jsx step 3 — read calcData.options[].amount instead of calcData.weekly/.fortnightly/.monthly. Currently $ amounts are blank in the plan-selection cards. Quick fix: const byFreq = Object.fromEntries((calcData.options||[]).map(o=>[o.frequency,o.amount])); then use byFreq.weekly etc.
FIX (MINOR): /api/bills/extract should always include 'category' key (even if null) so frontend can reset the Select cleanly.

critical_code_review_comments: DUPLICATE FUNCTION: server.py imports get_admin_user from utils.auth (line 47) then redefines it (line 1213). The local one wins via Python scoping and breaks Supabase token support. Lint/code-review process missed this.
API/UI contract mismatch: payment-plan/calculate returns nested options array but BillSetupWizard expects flat keys — no type/shape contract between BE and FE, easy to miss.

/api/bills/extract returns a dict shaped by whichever extraction path succeeded (pdfplumber vs vision) — fields are inconsistent (category, frequency may be missing). Recommend returning a normalised Pydantic model.
server.py is still 3004 lines — overdue for routes/ split.
BillSetupWizard.jsx 452 lines — fine, but four wizard-step blocks could be extracted into <Step1/>...<Step4/> sub-components for readability.

rca of the issue.admin_401: server.py imports get_admin_user from utils.auth at line 47 but defines its own at line 1213 (only does decode_token for custom JWT). Python late-binding means every @api_router.get('/admin/*') decorator's Depends(get_admin_user) resolves to the LOCAL function. Admin user now logs in via Supabase Auth (token starts with eyJhbGciOiJFUzI1NiI — ES256), local decode_token uses HS256+SECRET_KEY, decode throws InvalidTokenError -> 401. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/login admin -> token; GET /api/admin/stats with Bearer token -> {"detail":"Invalid token"} 401. Fix: delete server.py:1213-1223.
rca of the issue.plan_amounts_blank: API contract drift: /api/payment-plan/calculate returns {options:[{frequency,amount}]} but UI reads calcData.weekly. Reproduction: log in as test@billseasypay.com (no active plan), open Add Bill wizard, fill form, Confirm — Step 3 shows Weekly/Fortnightly/Monthly cards with empty $ amounts. Fix: map options to flat dict in fetchPlanData() or change backend to also expose weekly/fortnightly/monthly numeric keys.
